desc:
🌀 Welcome to Saiyan Farm!

🔓 Open lockers to pull your favorite fighters!
🏯 Place them on your plot to farm souls!
🗼Prove yourself and climb the Tower!
🎲 Roll ranks all the way up to LR and EX, with pity!
🧬 Unlock powerful traits!
🏃 Train on the treadmill for unlimited speed!
⬆️ Buy upgrades to farm even faster!
🎁 Claim daily rewards and session rewards!
🏆 Climb the Most Souls leaderboard!

👍 Like and join the group for +25% souls FOREVER!
